quotations.old_english: Swylce án ofen eall smóciende and leóhtberende fýr férde ofer ða lác
quotations.latin: apparuit clibanus fumans et lampas ignis inter divisiones illas

source_text: leóht-berende; adj. Light-bearing, Lucifer, luminous :-- Lucifer háten, leóht-berende, Cd. 221; Th. 287, 15; Sat. 367. Swylce án ofen eall smóciende and leóhtberende fýr férde ofer ða lác apparuit clibanus fumans et lampas ignis inter divisiones illas, Gen. 15, 17.
